criteria.point: Identifies Campus Atlas V1.8 as the project and Atlas as a stewarded continuity/context-transfer layer.
Identifies the first authentic mature-project Full Room Transfer proof as the current work.
Treats UI simplification as frozen at the accepted b042 commit and does not propose another UI slice.
Preserves Home = steering, Steward = task-specific Context Delivery, and Inspect = readable State Truth plus proof.
Distinguishes governed State Truth from task-specific Context Delivery rather than flattening them into generic memory.
Preserves the architecture: Exact evidence to governed State Truth to task-specific Context Delivery to fresh model computation.
Selects one real mature project room prospectively rather than using another synthetic fixture.
Requires the exact source cutoff, literal continuation task, rubric, and prohibited claims to be frozen before Steward output.
Uses a complete chronological source-room baseline and an Atlas-only compiledContent destination.
Uses genuinely fresh destinations with identical model/settings and no project memory, source-room access, hints, or manual explanation.
Freezes destination outputs verbatim before scoring.
Measures source and Atlas context independently using the accepted deterministic token estimate and reports actual reduction.
Requires equivalent or better accepted continuation behavior from Atlas versus the ordinary complete-transcript baseline.
Preserves current objective, causal rationale, governing decisions, corrections, supersessions, constraints, unresolved work, uncertainty, and next action when material.
Preserves material local terms and governing cross-topic connections without promoting mere associations.
Rejects stale, superseded, abandoned, resolved, repeated, and irrelevant state as current.
Does not invent unsupported project state, authority, history, proof results, or production status.
Audits every material supplied claim through governed record, correction/supersession relationship where relevant, finding/observation, canonical Exact event, and original message.
Keeps generic Roadway/Blueprint scaffolding visible and scores its relevance and token cost instead of hiding or pre-repairing it.
Does not change continuity runtime behavior, ranking, packet selection/compiler, governance, schemas, exact-source preservation, or receipt semantics during the proof.
Does not begin Mock Company, embeddings, ranking experiments, connectors, broad ingestion, automatic governance, or unrelated architecture work.
Stops at the first genuine failure and preserves exact expected-versus-actual evidence without repair.
Allows the observed failure category—not a roadmap preference—to select the smallest next change.
Keeps production and canonical production D1 unchanged during the local proof.

prohibitedClaims: Mock Company is the current next step.
Another UI simplification slice should run before the authentic proof.
The Part 3 synthetic noisy-room fixture is itself the authentic mature-project proof.
Atlas or the receiving model may rely on source-room access or hidden project memory.
A correct answer may pass when required private project truth was omitted from compiledContent and merely inferred.
Generic Roadway or Blueprint scaffolding is governed project State Truth.
Production already contains the frozen UI/runtime proof branch.
A failure should be repaired or rerun during this proof.
One authentic room establishes universal compression, broad reliability, or general long-term memory.
Sensitive, cross-project, or unsupported material may be included to improve completeness.
success: Atlas must match or exceed the baseline score with no material criterion lost, no prohibited claim, complete required lineage, and at least 50% estimated-token reduction. Packet-preservation gates must pass independently of destination behavior.
